name: module-flag-e2e-absolute-leg-fast-path
body: The per-language absolute-form legs generally take the freshness fast path, because `cmd_scan` canonicalises both spellings to one recorded module selection, so the absolute scan reuses the relative scan's graph: the legs pin driver resolution plus admission equivalence, not a second cold frontend invocation. A code-language scan also runs the bundled structural streams, so the assertion scopes the File query by the language's source suffix rather than by path alone. Upgrade by adding `--force` to the absolute leg if a scenario must prove the absolute spelling reaches a cold frontend run, or by dropping the suffix scope if the structural streams stop co-running.
